title: Relabel IMG_4111 after the ring cleanup: every real region named, every name on a region
user-messages: [recalled] ok partially fixed it, relabel 4111 anything unlabeled and then continue
description: The user removed the rings in IMG_4111.dsl that cut slivers on current code (repair_mesh changed under CRAW-93, so the old rings leaked into 150 slivers and 7 names covered no region). This ticket starts from the user's edited file and relabels: every unlabelled region that is a real part gets a name in IMG_4111's own pattern, every label resolves to the region it means, and no region is claimed by two labels. Labels only; rings stay as the user left them. IMG_4111 is the reference for the six segmentation tickets CRAW-95 to CRAW-100, whose round 2 waits on this.
definition-of-done:
1. IMG_4111.dsl reloads with every ring, no ring problem, no unlabelled real region, and every add_label resolving to its region.
2. No region is claimed by two labels.
3. Rings unchanged from the user's edit; only add_label statements change.
4. A launch entry opens the file in the ring scene and tmp/ holds whole-body screenshots with part names.
testing-plan:
1. model --path reloads the file; the region and label counts are checked from tools and ui-state.
2. The user reviews the names in the ring scene.
